_comment: One source for the loopstack-system MCP server (scripts/system/mcp.mjs) and the review gate (scripts/system/review.mjs): the three sizes, the tools agents call, the gates work passes on the way out, and the files the checks skip. Edit here and both change.

sizes.label: Sketch
sizes.who: A canvas board, mockup or spike
sizes.fixed: Tokens and the clinical-safety rules (SAFE-1 to SAFE-5)
checks: Colours come from the tokens (check_source flags anything raw)
Copy passes check_copy: no dosing instructions, no device-writing, no causal overclaims

sizes.label: Playground
sizes.who: In the app on a branch or a TestFlight build
sizes.fixed: Tokens, type, real components, safety and data-visual rules
checks: Colours come from the tokens; weights stop at 600
Reuse first: get_component names the nearest existing component
Charts follow the data-visual rules (get_rules "Data visuals"): locked scale, no dual axes, sample shown, missing drawn as missing

sizes.label: Production
sizes.who: What ships to the App Store or to a clinician
sizes.loose: Nothing without a reason written down
checks: Colours from the tokens, weights 400 to 600, grey text passes 4.5:1
Reuse first, and the component is in the registry with where it is documented
Copy passes check_copy and uses Loop's and clinicians' vocabulary
Every chart passes the data-visual rules and has a glance and a detail face
Images and meaningful SVG have text alternatives; real buttons and links; no positive tabIndex
States drawn: empty, not enough data yet, loading, error, long
Dynamic Type, reduced motion, 44px tap targets
npm test passes and system:review is clean

tools.name: search_system
tools.summary: Search rules, tokens, components and research at once.
tools.description: Search the LoopStack system: named rules and sections of DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md, colour tokens from src/styles/tokens.css, components in src/components and src/screens, and the research findings. Use it before building anything, to find what already exists and which rules apply.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.summary: Read a section of DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md, or one named rule.
tools.description: Return a section of DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md by heading (e.g. "Data visuals", "Clinical safety", "Colors") or a named rule by id (e.g. "VIS-3", "SAFE-1"). With no topic, lists every section and rule id.

tools.name: find_tokens
tools.summary: List colour tokens, or match a raw colour to the nearest token.
tools.description: List the colour tokens from src/styles/tokens.css, or, given a raw hex, return the nearest token and how far it is. Use it instead of writing a hex.

tools.name: get_component
tools.summary: Find a component and its registry entry.
tools.description: Look up a component by name in src/components and src/screens: its files, its registry size and where it is documented, and the nearest similar components. Use it before adding a component.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.summary: The checks for a sketch, playground or production change.
tools.description: Return what is fixed, what is loose and what to check for work at a given size: sketch, playground or production.

tools.name: check_source
tools.summary: Check TSX, TS or CSS against the system.
tools.description: Check code for drift: raw colours (COL-1), 700+ weights (TYPE-1), too-light grey text (COL-4), images without alt, positive tabIndex, click handlers on non-interactive elements, and the clinical-safety and vocabulary rules in any copy it contains.

tools.name: check_copy
tools.summary: Check copy against the safety and brand rules.
tools.description: Check user-facing copy (plain text, markdown or TSX) for dosing instructions (SAFE-1), unmeasured outcome claims (SAFE-2), device-writing language (SAFE-3), causal overclaims (SAFE-4), bolus/basal ratio (DATA-1), clinician vocabulary (DATA-2), product names (BRAND-1) and implied affiliation (BRAND-2).

tools.name: get_research
tools.summary: Findings, unmet needs and sources from the 16 research topics.
tools.description: Search the DIY Loop and clinician research (diy-loop-clinician-research/results): returns each matching topic's severity, safety rating, unmet need and implication for LoopStack, with its top sources. With no query, lists the topics.

tools.name: get_decisions
tools.summary: Open decisions waiting on the owner.
tools.description: Return the open decisions: DECISIONS-PENDING.md, and the open decisions in the research report.

tools.name: audit_drift
tools.summary: Count existing drift across the whole tree.
tools.description: Run check_source over every file in src (except the exempt files) and return counts by finding code and by file. Drift that predates a change is reported here, not by review_change.

tools.name: review_change
tools.summary: Run the review gate on the working tree before committing.
tools.description: Check the lines this branch adds compared with a git ref (default HEAD, so uncommitted work): blocking findings stop the change, the rest are reported. Same as npm run system:review.

gates.check: check_source, check_copy and get_rules over MCP
system:review on added lines: clinical-safety findings (SAFE-1, SAFE-3, SAFE-5), raw colours with a token, images without alt, positive tabIndex
system:review on added lines: other copy, vocabulary, weight, contrast and accessibility findings; components missing from the registry
npm test and npm run build
